main_text.l: PHOCAS
NICEPHORVS
ZIMISCEN[?]
JOANNES
NICEPHORVS Phocas Constantinopoli imperat an-
no mundi 4922. à Christo nato 960. Cum Saracenis sæpe ac
feliciter congressus est, qui Calabriam, Siciliam, Candiam, Cili-
cia & Cyprum occuparant: in Sicilia res haud ita bene per du-
ces acta est: ipse Ciliciam, & bonam Asiæ partem lætis recepit
auspiciis: mox Antiochiam noctu aggressus, pulsis Saracenis
imperio eam adiecit. Invisus omnibus fuit, quòd bellorum prætextu novis tributis & exactionibus populum expilaret, numis-
mata adulteraret, ac pondus imminueret: quare odiosus civi-
bus, facile à Joanne Zimisce, noctu dormiens in cubili occidit-
ur: intromittente etiam sicarios, Theophania Nicephori uxo-
re. imperat annos decem. Vide Egnat. Ro. prin. lib. 2. & Cosmo-
grap. Mun. de Græcia lib. 4.
JOANNES Zimisces occiso, ut dixi, Nicephoro, post eum
imperat Constantinopoli, an. mun. 4932. à Christo nato 970.
Hic clarus antea militari laude, in Roxolanos feliciter movet,
Bulgariamque totam, quam sibi[?] Roxolani vendicabant, impe-
rio subiicit, Sphendoslauo eorum Rege ad deditionem coacto.
Basilium & Constantinum fratres, Romani secundi supradicti
filios, Cæsares facit, ac imperij consortes creat: Nicephoro de-
ditos è medio tollit: & damnatos exilio ab eodem, reducit. At
mox parta de Roxolanis victoria, cum triumphantis specie Con-
stantinopolim ingressus esset, veneno potatur, post annum im-
perij sextum. Vide ut supra.

page.notes: Medallion portraits: left, a bearded man in a crown or helmet, legend PHOCAS on the left rim and NICEPHORVS on the right rim; right, a bearded man with a crown, legend ZIMISCEN (last letter doubtful) on the left rim and JOANNES on the right rim. The line "JOANNES" in the medallion is written as printed; the medallion legends are placed before the text. Doubtful: "sibi" is partly obscured by a stain in the printed line, read as "sibi" with [?]. Long s has been normalised to s; u/v and i/j normalised to modern usage (Inuisus as Invisus, Ioanne as Joanne). The page number is printed as "143" at top right.
